title: Organization
description: General organizational entity that can represent companies, non-profits, institutions, or any structured group. Contains organizational details, contact information, size metrics, and founding information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the organization record

name.description: Official legal name of the organization

type.description: Type of organization (e.g., corporation, non-profit, government, educational institution, startup)

description.description: Comprehensive description of the organization's mission, activities, and purpose

website.description: Official website URL of the organization

email.description: Primary contact email address for the organization

phone.description: Main contact phone number for the organization

address.description: Street address of the organization's primary location

city.description: City where the organization is headquartered

country.description: Country where the organization is based or primarily operates

employees.description: Total number of employees or members in the organization

founded.description: Year when the organization was established or founded

logo.description: URL to the organization's official logo image
